conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional mapped attacker without CharacterId
conditional_findings.classification: Prior 059 finding independently reconnected to 95e source; no new historical finding or additional proven unique issue.
conditional_findings.trace: The client observer requires a target with GlobalTransform, then calls combat_sound_seed for the attacker before checking the independent spark/blood branches. Missing CharacterId returns None and exits the entire observer, including requested visual effects. Current sound output changed to SoundFamily and platform playback, but that pre-visual seed gate remains.
conditional_findings.producer_safeguards: The server emits SuccessfulAttackResponse from melee and ranged outcomes with authoritative impact flags. Its authoritative_impact_effects returns sound None only for a no-physical-contact ToAttacker case, for which both blood and metal-spark predicates are false; ToDefender branches choose an actual sound variant. Thus the earlier illustrative sound-None-plus-visual combination is not established from this inspected authoritative producer. CharacterId is added with the normal projected Player and is replicated. The event maps attacker, hit and impact recipient entities; the pinned Replicon decode reports an error when entity mapping fails rather than returning a successfully mapped message for that attempt. Successful entity mapping is not, by itself, proof that the mapped entity has CharacterId at observer time.
conditional_findings.remaining_case: A successfully delivered mapped event whose attacker lacks the CharacterId component while its target and visual flags remain available would still take the early return. Whether such a state is permitted or reachable through actual replication, lifetime and removal ordering is unresolved; no event, component race, missing effect or sound was observed.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Requested visual impact channels should not be silently suppressed by an unavailable audio-only seed unless event admission guarantees the required identity and makes its failure explicit.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Combat effect channel preparation and event identity/seed context, with authoritative impact semantics and replication lifecycle connected.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: Determine the actual event/identity guarantee and, if missing identity is admitted, keep sound seed failure separate from independent visual effects; preserve deterministic audio and the server-owned impact semantics.
conditional_findings.later_acceptance: Only after separate implementation and product-validation authorization, exercise valid mapped events, sound and visual combinations, identity timing/removal and any explicit rejection policy.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; actual mapped-component lifetime, all event producers and aliases remain open

conditional_findings.classification: Prior 059 finding independently reconnected to byte-identical 95e source; no new historical finding or additional proven unique issue.
conditional_findings.trace: closest_surface_uv inverse-transforms the same impact point into each descendant surface local frame, finds a closest local triangle and UV, and compares their raw local distance_squared values across candidate meshes. Normal rig loading attaches the authored scene under the player; resolved worn procedural equipment is attached under the rig scene, skin bindings derive joints from the owner, and the interior material preparation installs a source marker on renderable meshes. Those source paths establish a relevant hierarchy and possible skinned representation, not actual unequal surface scales or a measured hit.
conditional_findings.symbolic_case: For a common scene impact point and two candidate surfaces, a local gap 0.2 under uniform scale 10 represents scene gap 2.0, while local gap 0.3 under scale 1 represents scene gap 0.3. The compared local squares 0.04 and 0.09 select the first despite its larger scene gap. Nonuniform scale can also change which triangle point is closest; multiplying by a guessed scalar is not a general correction. This is symbolic geometry, not a rendered surface, generated mesh or physics fixture.
conditional_findings.limits: The query reads Mesh vertex attributes and GlobalTransform, without querying the SkinnedMesh pose or morph weights. The attachment/binding source does not prove that any particular target surface is queried, has unequal scale, or exhibits a posed-surface mismatch. Direct target meshes are excluded by the descendant check, but the inspected normal rig path uses child entities; whether other supported producers place an eligible mesh on the target itself remains open.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Distances used to rank different surface candidates must share the intended scene-space metric while retaining UV and geometry provenance.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Blood surface geometric observation, candidate scene-space metric and UV provenance.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: Compute and compare closest points in a common intended frame, explicitly address supported nonuniform transforms and rendered deformation, and preserve normal unscaled mask/UV behavior.
conditional_findings.later_acceptance: Only after separate implementation and product-validation authorization, compare equivalent differently scaled candidates, posed surfaces, normal unscaled geometry and missing/invalid data.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; actual surface scales, skinned/morph geometry, hierarchy and exact aliases remain open

conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; retained representation and owner-fit review
conditional_findings.classification: Prior e275 Lens1 finding independently reconnected to 95e source; no new historical finding or additional proven unique issue.
conditional_findings.trace: CharacterId is an immutable, ordered/hashable bespoke strategic identity component replicated into the tactical world. combat_sound_seed obtains it from the attacker but strips .0 into a u64 key stored in a Local BTreeMap before converting that number to Seed. The counter itself and seed word have separate numeric roles. Current playback routes through SoundFamily/sound_output, but the identity extraction and retained map remain.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The retained private sequence key should preserve the existing character identity owner until the deterministic seed-word boundary.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: CharacterId for the character-keyed sequence map; the sequence counter and Seed adapter remain separate.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: Retain CharacterId in the private lookup/map and convert only where Seed needs a primitive, preserving zero, wrapping sequence, cross-session and deterministic-stream policy.
conditional_findings.later_acceptance: Only after separate implementation and product-validation authorization, compare event sequences, normal playback and lifecycle behavior with current deterministic contracts.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; event identity lifecycle, audio backend behavior and exact aliases remain open
